name: Adding products to the cart updates the header cart counter and cart summary
description: Adding the same product twice and a second product once makes the header cart badge show 3, the cart summary lists both products, and Clear Cart resets the badge to 0.

planSteps.description: Click Add to Cart on the Aurora headphones product card
Click Add to Cart on the Aurora headphones product card again
Click Add to Cart on the Ember mug product card
Verify the cart counter badge in the page header shows 3, and the cart summary panel lists the Aurora headphones with quantity 2 and the Ember mug with quantity 1
Click the Clear Cart button in the cart summary panel
Verify the cart counter badge in the page header shows 0 and the cart summary panel says the cart is empty
